summary: Frontend testing of ACTOOS PRO - Login, Clients, Interventions, Devis, Factures, Import, and all 10 Settings tabs. Most features working correctly. Found 1 critical bug: 'Nouvelle facture vierge' route missing.

ui_bugs.issue: Route /dashboard/factures/new does not exist. Clicking 'Nouvelle facture vierge' from dropdown shows 'Facture non trouvée'. Missing FactureForm component and route in App.js

action_items: Add FactureForm component to Factures.jsx (similar to DevisForm)
Add route '/dashboard/factures/new' to App.js pointing to FactureForm
critical_code_review_comments: App.js line 270-271: Factures routes only have list and detail, missing /new route
Factures.jsx: Only exports FacturesList and FactureDetail, no FactureForm component
The dropdown menu in FacturesList has 'Nouvelle facture vierge' option that navigates to non-existent route
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Client_Playwright and TEST_Intervention_Playwright for testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Settings tabs working (10/10). Client creation working. Intervention creation working. Devis form working. Import page working with 5-step wizard. Factures list working with dropdown. Only issue: 'Nouvelle facture vierge' route missing - need to add FactureForm component and route.

test_1_login.details: Login with contact@actoos.com / Salifkane&&7 works. Redirects to /dashboard. Enterprise plan confirmed.

test_2_create_client.details: Created TEST_Client_Playwright Test with email, phone, address. Client appears in list.

test_3_create_intervention.details: Created TEST_Intervention_Playwright with client selection. Intervention appears in list.

test_4_devis_form.details: Devis form loads correctly. Client selector, line items, totals calculation (HT/TVA/TTC) all working.

test_5_factures_list.details: Factures list loads. Dropdown shows 3 options: Nouvelle facture vierge, Depuis un devis, Depuis une intervention.

test_6_facture_vierge.details: Clicking 'Nouvelle facture vierge' navigates to /factures/new which shows 'Facture non trouvée'. Route and component missing.

test_7_import_page.details: Import page shows 5-step wizard (Entity, Upload, Mapping, Preview, Import). Can import Clients, Interventions, Devis, Factures.

test_8_settings_tabs.details: All 10 tabs working: Entreprise, Abonnement, Catégories, Notifications, Documents, Personnalisation, Devise, Intégrations, RGPD, Sécurité

test_9_logo_upload.details: Personnalisation tab shows logo upload button and color picker. Formats: PNG, JPG, WebP. Max 2MB.

test_10_partial_payment.details: Could not test partial payment because facture creation from scratch is broken. Need to fix facture creation first.

settings_tabs_verified.entreprise: Company info form (Nom, Email, Téléphone, Adresse, SIRET, TVA)
settings_tabs_verified.abonnement: Enterprise plan with usage stats, Changer de plan button, Annuler abonnement
settings_tabs_verified.categories: Categories management with Nouvelle catégorie button
settings_tabs_verified.notifications: Push and Email notification toggles for interventions, devis, factures, relances
settings_tabs_verified.documents: Conditions générales, Message client (Devis/Factures), Validité devis
settings_tabs_verified.personnalisation: Logo upload, Color picker with preview
settings_tabs_verified.securite: 2FA options (Google Authenticator, Email), Password change form
